question.text:
Which of the following statement is/are correct?

I. The ligand thiosuphato, S2O32- can give rise to linkage isomers.

II. In metallic carbonyls the ligand CO molecule acts both as donor and acceptor.

III. The complex PtPyNH3NO2ClBrI exists in eight different geometrical isomeric forms

IV. The complex ferricyanide ion does not follow effective atomic number (EAN) rule.

solution.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msubsup></math>  can give rise to linkage isomers as it can coordinate through both O and S atoms. Ligand CO molecule acts both as donor and acceptor by donating pi electron and accepting electron form metal into its vacant  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">*</mi></mrow></msup></math>  molecular orbital. Hence here I and II are correct and in case of ferricyanide ion effective atomic number is 35 so IV is also correct.
